narrative.overview:
beexie treats browser-side pixel art conversion like inspecting a calibrated Risograph proof on a press bench. Warm Cotton-Press Ivory (`#f8f6f1`) and crisp white press sheets (`#ffffff`) form the daylight drafting ground, while the paired Pressroom Charcoal (`#12141a`) and dark sheet (`#191c23`) theme supports low-glare color inspection. Electric Cobalt (`#1e46e8` light / `#2d55eb` dark) marks every active commitment, export action, and pure-accent pointer-tracking Spotlight Card glow (`[data-spotlight]`), while Proof Vermilion (`#eb4a2d` light / `#ff5a3c` dark) stays scoped to comparison and live indicators: the split comparison rule, the Landing dither switch track, the active-session pulse dot, and the tail stripe of the geometric `<BeeMark />` emblem.

Across both the Landing showcase and the Studio workbench, structural separation relies on crisp `1px` hairlines (`#dcd7cc` light / `#2d323e` dark), spacing-grouped Studio sections (`.panel-group`) instead of nested boxes, concentric radii governed by `inner = outer - padding`, and mirrored flowing cubic-Bezier `BackgroundPaths` curves (`Path2D` Canvas 2D). On Landing, 72 symmetric curves sweep smoothly behind a live interactive split proof of the 1024x1024 koi pond specimen (`public/specimen.jpg`), a framed 4-column Pipeline Proof Sheet (`.pipeline-sheet-frame`), and a framed `0.84fr / 1.36fr` Split FAQ Accordion Sheet (`.faq-sheet-frame`). Inside the Studio workbench, `BackgroundPaths` pauses to a calm static frame while a `64px` numbered `01-04` rail frees the center bench for nearest-neighbor previews (`image-rendering: pixelated`) and a pinned dashed-rule Export ticket.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-theme press calibration: Cotton-Press Ivory (`#f8f6f1`) for daylight drafting and Pressroom Charcoal (`#12141a`) for low-glare proofing, passing all 18 WCAG AA contrast checks.

Spot-ink role discipline: Electric Cobalt owns action, selection, and pure-accent Spotlight Card radial glow; Proof Vermilion marks compare sliders, the dither switch, the session dot, and the bee tail accent.

Strict mono-only-on-data typography: `Archivo` owns UI labels and headings in sentence case while `Martian Mono` with `tabular-nums` renders only numeric coordinates, grid counts, zoom percentages, hex codes, and `01-04` stage indices.
Mathematical nested geometry: concentric sheets and segmented controls compute inner corners directly from outer radius minus padding (`14px - 10px = 4px`, `9px - 3px = 6px`).

Motion restraint and loading clarity: flowing `BackgroundPaths` ribbons and Cobalt Spotlight hover tracking on Landing, static framing in Studio, unified `strokeWidth={1.75}` SVG spinners (`SpinnerIcon`) across specimen decode and pixel processing, and global `0s` transitions under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.

rules.name: The Dual-Ink Economy Rule
rules.body: Electric Cobalt (`#1e46e8` light / `#2d55eb` dark) owns interactive commitment (primary CTAs, active stage rail tile, active presets, active segmented views, toggles, focus rings) and pure-accent `[data-spotlight]` card glow; Proof Vermilion (`#eb4a2d` light / `#ff5a3c` dark) stays scoped to inspection markers (compare split rule and handle, Landing dither switch track, `Resume` pulse indicator, and `<BeeMark />` tail stripe) while text-grade `--vermilion-text` (`#c23117` light / `#ff8770` dark) handles readable danger/alert copy.

rules.name: The Dual-Theme Contrast Parity Rule
rules.body: Light Cotton-Press Ivory and Dark Pressroom Charcoal pair distinct fill, text, and rule tokens (`--accent` `#1e46e8` / `#2d55eb` vs. `--accent-text` `#1e46e8` / `#85aaff`, `--ink-2` `#3d414a` / `#c6cbd6`, `--ink-3` `#575b64` / `#9ea5b5`, `--vermilion-text` `#c23117` / `#ff8770`) so all 18 WCAG AA checks (`>= 4.5:1` text, `>= 3.0:1` UI borders) pass simultaneously.

rules.name: The Calm Pressroom Backdrop Rule
rules.body: The `BackgroundPaths` canvas animates mirrored cubic-Bezier curves on Landing and pauses to low-opacity static guide lines inside the Studio workbench (and under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`), while `[data-spotlight]` cards restrict glow purely to Electric Cobalt on fine-pointer hover so ambient motion never distorts pixel color evaluation.

rules.name: The Strict Mono-Only-On-Data Rule
rules.body: UI chrome labels, field heads, preset sub-captions, stage names, and ticket headings remain in `Archivo` (`--font-ui`, sentence case), reserving `Martian Mono` (`--font-mono`) strictly for numeric coordinates, grid dimensions, zoom percentages, hex codes, byte sizes, and `01`-`04` stage indices.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every `Martian Mono` readout and numeric input enforces `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` (`.mono`, `.tnum`) so live slider scrubbing and viewport resizing never cause horizontal jitter.

rules.name: The Tight Display Tracking Rule
rules.body: `Bricolage Grotesque` headings (`800` weight) use tight negative letter-spacing (`-0.015em` to `-0.032em`) with `text-wrap: balance`, while `Archivo` body text and `Martian Mono` data values stay at normal tracking with zero forced uppercase transforms.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Layering Rule
rules.body: Structural panes and interior sheet subdivisions (`AppHeader`, `64px` `ToolRail`, `Inspector` `.panel-group` sections, `.pipeline-step` columns, and `.faq-row` accordion items) separate cleanly with `1px` `--line-subtle` hairlines and spacing; ambient `--shadow-frame` lift and pure-Cobalt `[data-spotlight]` glows belong exclusively to top-level matte proof sheets (`.hero-proof-sheet`, `.pipeline-sheet-frame`, `.faq-sheet-frame`, `.footer-cta-card`, `.proof-sheet`, and `.empty-bench`).

rules.name: The Nested Radii Parity Rule
rules.body: Nested containers obey `inner radius = outer radius - padding` (`--r-sheet` `14px` minus `--p-sheet` `10px` equals `--r-sheet-inner` `4px`; `--r-seg` `9px` minus `--p-seg` `3px` equals `--r-seg-inner` `6px`), keeping concentric frames optically parallel across every viewport and breakpoint.

dos: Do group inspector and landing sections by `--s-5` / `--s-6` spacing and `1px` `--line-subtle` hairlines rather than wrapping nested cards inside cards.
Do preserve `inner radius = outer radius - padding` (`14px - 10px = 4px` on proof sheets; `9px - 3px = 6px` on segmented tracks and zoom bars).
Do keep UI field labels in `Archivo` sentence case and restrict `Martian Mono` (`tabular-nums`) strictly to pixel coordinates, dimensions, hex codes, zoom percentages, and `01`-`04` indices.
Do enforce `image-rendering: pixelated` and `imageSmoothingEnabled = false` on every pixel-art preview and thumbnail.
Do pause `BackgroundPaths` inside the Studio workbench, respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` and coarse-pointer spotlight disables, and pass all 18 checks in `npm run check:contrast`.
donts: Don't use Vermilion (`#eb4a2d` / `#ff5a3c`) for primary CTAs, stage rail buttons, or small text; reserve `--vermilion` for inspection markers and use `--vermilion-text` (`#c23117` / `#ff8770`) for alert and error text.
Don't use `#85aaff` (`--accent-text`) as a dark-theme button fill behind `#ffffff` text; keep `#2d55eb` (`--accent`) as the dark button background and `#85aaff` for text and focus rings.
Don't reintroduce `+` corner registration ticks, boxed `.ins-card` subcards, uppercase monospace labels, or `04 EXPORT DISPATCH` headers over the streamlined proof sheet and Export ticket.

Don't link external CDN font stylesheets or icon-font kits; keep `Archivo`, `Bricolage Grotesque`, and `Martian Mono` self-hosted in `src/assets/fonts/` and UI icons as `strokeWidth={1.75}` inline SVGs in `src/components/icons.tsx`.
